stories.title: AUSL All-Star Cup — Series 3 Captains Announced, Team Draft Set for August 22
stories.angle: The three Series 3 captains are confirmed: Keilani Ricketts, Danieca Coffey, and Devyn Netz. Team draft is Friday, August 22. Games run August 24–26 at Parkway Bank Sports Complex, Rosemont, IL. Kayla Kowalik is not a Series 3 captain but leads the individual points race — she has won the Game MVP in every game through Series 2 (4 of 4), accumulating 220 MVP points and 150 stat points. Biggest Series 2 mover: Sierra Romero, up 42 spots to No. 9 overall. Emma Lemley rose 26 spots.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Series 3 captains are set: Keilani Ricketts. Danieca Coffey. Devyn Netz. The AUSL All-Star Cup team draft is Friday, Aug. 22 — then games begin Aug. 24 in Rosemont. Kowalik leads the individual race. Can she hold it? #AUSL #SoftballIsForEveryone

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Sierra Romero jumped 42 spots in Series 2 — all the way to No. 9 in the individual race. Kowalik still leads. But with three new captains and a draft on Aug. 22, this thing is wide open. AUSL All-Star Cup resumes Aug. 24 in Rosemont. #AUSL #ILoveSoftball

stories.title: Oklahoma Softball — First WCWS Miss Since 2015, Gasso Rebuilding
stories.angle: For the first time since 2015, Patty Gasso's Oklahoma Sooners did not reach the Women's College World Series. OU fell in a Game 3 Super Regional loss to Mississippi State. With multiple departures in the portal, Gasso has publicly said she will "take a look-see in the portal to see what we can find." Key exits: Berkley Zache (P), Riley Zache (C/INF), Tia Milloy (UTL). Key addition: RHP Miali Guachino from Ole Miss. Top 2026 recruit Payton Westra has enrolled. This is the biggest rebuild story in college softball heading into 2027.

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: For the first time since 2015, Oklahoma won't be at the WCWS. Super Regional loss to Mississippi State. Gasso says the portal is on the radar. The rebuild starts now. #OUSoftball #Sooners #WCWSSoftball

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: OU lost three key portal pieces this offseason. They added RHP Miali Guachino from Ole Miss. No. 2 recruit Payton Westra is enrolled. Now Gasso needs a true ace. The 2027 Sooners are being built from the ground up. #OUSoftball #Sooners

stories.title: September 1 — 15 Days to D1 First-Contact Window (Class of 2028)
stories.angle: 15 days. Extra Inning Softball has a September 1 nomination deadline for the Class of 2028 rankings — pitchers, catchers, infielders, and outfielders will be ranked post-deadline. Coaches have been watching this class all summer at showcase events. The programs that call first on September 1 are signaling their top priorities. Athletes who have film in coaches' systems right now are already ahead. This week — the final two weeks before the window — is the last chance to make an impression.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text: 15 days until September 1. When that window opens, coaches don't wait — the call lists are already built. For Class of 2028 families: your athlete's film needs to be current and their name needs to be in the system. Now. #SoftballRecruiting #ClassOf2028

stories.title: USA WNT — 26 Days to World Cup, Group C Breakdown
stories.angle: 26 days until USA Softball opens Group Stage play in Oklahoma City. USA's Group C opponents, ranked by WBSC: Netherlands (No. 6), Mexico (No. 7), China (No. 8), New Zealand (No. 23), South Africa (No. 36). Top 2 teams in the group advance to the 2027 World Cup in Brisbane, Australia. The Netherlands and Mexico are the credible threats on paper. The conference breakdown of the 16-player USA roster: SEC leads with 10 players; Big 12 has 3; Big Ten has 3.

stories.title: Texas Longhorns — 11 New Additions, Competition for Every Spot Begins
stories.angle: With the staff fully assembled, Mike White now has his full 2027 roster picture in focus. Of the 24 players on the Texas roster heading into fall, 11 are new additions — transfers plus freshmen. White said publicly: "Of the 24 players on our roster, 11 are new additions, so that means a lot of competition within the team for starting positions this year." Teagan Kavan enters her senior year as the program's two-time WCWS MOP. Only UCLA (1988–90) and Oklahoma (2021–23) have ever won three consecutive national titles.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: 11 of Texas softball's 24 roster spots belong to new additions. Mike White's words: "a lot of competition within the team for starting positions this year." Kavan enters her senior year. The three-peat chase begins with competition from within. #TexasSoftball #Longhorns
